A nested table wrapped in a div still renders as its own table rather than raw pipes

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<div><table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></div></td></tr></table>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
